summary: Streaming 'connection closed' mid-response reported by customer (OpenAI-compatible chat)
description:
Customer report:
Cobalt Assist reports that streamed chat responses sometimes fail with a client-side error message 'connection closed' and the final answer is incomplete. Their app expects streaming to end with a terminal event; instead it ends abruptly.

Triage notes:
- They use our OpenAI-compatible endpoint with stream=true
- They see it more often on responses that invoke tools / longer reasoning paths

Finding:
Matches known issue related to downstream idle timeouts when no bytes are sent for ~30s.

Resolution:
Added customer to fix rollout tracking (keep-alive flush) and provided interim workaround guidance (increase reverse proxy idle timeout on their side; optionally disable tool usage for long calls).
comments: Chloe Martin (Support): Customer escalated to their VP Eng. They are seeing 'connection closed' in their gateway logs and incomplete assistant messages.
Ethan Park: Symptom consistent with SUP-5321. Request IDs show long pauses between streamed chunks; downstream connection closed.
Chloe Martin: Provided Confluence known-issue link + workaround. Customer asked for ETA for us-west.
Ethan Park: us-west deployed keep-alive 11/19; asked customer to retest and share failures if any remain.
Chloe Martin: Customer confirmed no truncations observed in 24h post-deploy. Resolving.
